description: Weekly, grouped update PRs for everything this repo pins; never automerged. See CLAUDE.md, 'Dependency updates'.

poetry.description: paperbridge builds with hatchling; off, so the pep621 manager also tracks build-system.requires.

customManagers.description: The upstream commit our translation-server image is built from: follow zotero/translation-server master.
The MicroK8s snap channel in host/01-microk8s.sh. canonical/microk8s publishes a GitHub release (v1.36) when a minor reaches stable.
The Traefik chart that host/01-microk8s.sh installs through the MicroK8s ingress addon.

packageRules.description: Cluster images: one PR. Takes effect with kubectl apply -k k8s/.
prBodyNotes: To deploy after merging: `kubectl apply -k k8s/`, then check the changed apps (CLAUDE.md, Status).

packageRules.description: paperbridge's Python packages and base image: one PR, tested by the paperbridge workflow.
prBodyNotes: Nothing changes in the cluster until the next paperbridge release: bump `version` in `services/paperbridge/pyproject.toml`, push the matching `vX.Y.Z` tag, then pin the new image digest in `k8s/research/paperbridge/cronjob.yaml` and apply.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one PR, pinned to commit digests (config:best-practices).
Host scripts: take effect only when the owner reruns them on the server with sudo.
prBodyNotes: To deploy after merging: copy `host/01-microk8s.sh` to the server and run it with sudo (README, Rebuild).

packageRules.description: translation-server: merging rebuilds our image from the new upstream commit.
prBodyNotes: Merging builds `ghcr.io/mufflon/translation-server:<first 12 chars of the commit>` (`.github/workflows/translation-server.yml`). Then put that tag and its digest into `k8s/research/translation-server/deployment.yaml` and apply.

packageRules.description: Our own images: their tags and digests are set when we release them, not by Renovate.
karakeep-chrome tags are <Chrome version>-r<n>; ignore the per-architecture -amd64/-arm64 tags.
Meilisearch stays on the version Karakeep pins until a newer one is verified with Karakeep's client: PRs only on request from the dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Karakeep pins its own Meilisearch version. Check Karakeep's docker-compose for the version it uses before merging.

packageRules.description: A Kubernetes minor upgrades the cluster: the MicroK8s channel and kubectl in the lego CronJob move together, on request from the dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Upgrade one minor at a time. After merging, rerun `host/01-microk8s.sh` on the server (it refreshes the snap to the new channel), then `kubectl apply -k k8s/`.
